content: First, we introduce an expectation regularization technique for the weakly supervised learning of the target model $p_{\theta ^{(t)}}(y|x)$. In this setting, the objective function of the target model is composed of two parts, corresponding to the labeled microposts $\mathcal {L}$ and the unlabeled ones $\mathcal {U}$.
